description.text:
A collection of reprints released in May 2002: 110 cards from Base Set to Team Rocket, in their original card designs, sold only outside Japan. It introduced reverse holos to the game: every card also came in a copy with foil in a firework pattern over the whole card except the picture, an idea Wizards of the Coast brought over from Magic: The Gathering.

It was also the first set with box toppers, oversized reverse holo copies of Charizard, Dark Blastoise, Dark Raichu and Mewtwo found only in sealed booster boxes. Its theme decks, Lava and Turmoil, held non-holo prints of Charizard, Dark Blastoise and Dark Raichu found nowhere else, and one reverse holo each.

description.text: Legendary Collection reprinted Base Set's Machamp in 2002 as 15/110, a holo rare. Base Set's had come only in starter sets, so this was the first English print of the card sold in booster packs. The reprint updates the wording of its Pokémon Power: Strikes Back can't be used if Machamp is affected by a Special Condition, where Base Set's listed Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed.

description.text: The reverse holo copy: foil in Legendary Collection's firework pattern over the whole card except the picture, the other way round from the holo copy, whose picture is the foil part. Legendary Collection was the first set with reverse holos; every card in it came this way too, in random booster packs.

description.text:
Legendary Collection, Wizards of the Coast's May 2002 set of reprints of the game's earliest cards, introduced box toppers to the Pokémon TCG: four oversized cards found only in sealed booster boxes. Each is a larger reverse holo copy of one of the set's cards, numbered S1/S4 to S4/S4 with a P, and its sparkle is an almost checkered take on the firework pattern of the set's reverse holos. Wizards gave the next three sets, Expedition, Aquapolis and Skyridge, box toppers too, numbered in a run of twelve.

This is Charizard, S1/S4, a copy of the set's Charizard 3/110, drawn by Mitsuhiro Arita. The set's Lava theme deck held another exclusive print of the same card, without holofoil.
